text.tspan: Monthly spending on data center construction in the United States
Cost of privately-funded construction of data centers each month, including materials and labor. It excludes the
cost of IT hardware like servers and storage, which can account for a large share of total investment. This data is
expressed in US dollars, adjusted for inflation.
Data source: United States Census Bureau (2026); U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (2026)
Note: This data is expressed in constant 2021 US$.
